answer: Registration requires solving a per-epoch computational puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of identities created in the last window, so a bulk creator pays 4 times more work than the first joiner. The puzzle turns an hollow of cheap keys into a metered resource, and each solved instance is recorded so the same ridge of work cannot be recycled for a second identity. The dune effect is that the marginal fake identity always costs more than the marginal honest one. Signatures are ed25519 over the transaction id, which makes forgery detectable without a trusted third party.
